scientific.integrity: The bias-corrected first and second moments are solved exactly for the alternating constant-magnitude signal. The second moment equals the raw squared magnitude exactly, and the first moment has an exact parity law.
limitations: Interpolation regime for the immediate-discount parameters.
Input-response theorem rather than fixed-objective convergence.
General stochastic gradients need not erase the second-moment parameters.

title: QHAdam has an exact Nyquist attenuation floor
